_comment: Mutation testing config — see docs/qa-strategy.md § Mutation testing. Scope (v2): traces.js (render path) + filters.js (signal processing) + topo2d.js (electrode-position layout) + bids-recording.js (metadata loader). viewer.js and worker.js are excluded because their IIFE/worker context depends on DOM/worker globals node:test cannot provide.
